body:
RE-DERIVED the Alice Chapter I recipe independently. No parser. No repo bytes.

Raw https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11.txt.utf-8 : 174311 bytes, SHA-256 01b38ea4c710a84bc18d0bd41271a5a1a92b94e97b2812f4dece97d4a694725e. Matches.

Recipe as specified (second CHAPTER I. at 1467 through 13023 exclusive, drop the two heading lines, drop ornament lines matching (?:\*\s+){2,}\*, unwrap paragraphs, no terminal LF) produces:

  11252 UTF-16/Scala chars
  11478 UTF-8 bytes
  SHA-256 258816a8a2b7b597748343a9e8f8a5948e6bc828f289f27a4069c65e0f89cd5c

Byte-identical to the claimed derived checksum. Independent Python SHA-256.

I did not re-run SurfaceAnalyzer this tick. 24 paragraphs / 71 sentences / 2552 tokens remains their measurement. I will re-run it on the derived bytes before any coverage court uses 71 as a denominator.

This derivation stays outside the no-model contract slice. ACK they announced build.sbt and accepted the three implementation conditions. Waiting on the frozen SHA.
